sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS MAY DEVELOP IN EPISODES FROM MID-AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS...WITH LARGE HAIL AND OCNL DAMAGING GUSTS BEING MAIN CONCERNS. SIGNIFICANT/DAMAGING HAIL IS POSSIBLE WHERE INFLOW-LAYER MOISTURE AND THEREFORE BUOYANCY IS MAXIMIZED...WHICH APPEARS MOST PROBABLE ATTM FROM PORTIONS TX PANHANDLE NWD TO SERN CO. FCST HODOGRAPHS SUPPORT POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS...AS DOES FCST 45-55 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES ACROSS MUCH OF THIS CORRIDOR. A FEW FACTORS MAY LIMIT TSTM COVERAGE AND/OR DELAY INITIATION OVER THIS CORRIDOR. THESE INCLUDE PRESENCE OF DENSE CIRRUS CLOUD COVER OVER MUCH OF AREA WHICH WILL LIMIT PACE/MAGNITUDE OF SFC HEATING...LACK OF MORE ROBUST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ESPECIALLY OVER CO/KS/NEB PORTION OF OUTLOOK...AND LATE EVENING/OVERNIGHT ARRIVAL OF STRONGEST DEEP-LAYER ASCENT PRECEDING

sections.title: SRN WV/ERN KY TO MID-SOUTH REGION AND ERN OK
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG/AHEAD OF SFC COLD FRONT DURING AFTERNOON...PRIMARILY MULTICELLULAR IN MODE WITH DAMAGING GUSTS AND SPORADIC LARGE HAIL EXPECTED. TRANSIENT SUPERCELL/BOWING STRUCTURES ALSO ARE POSSIBLE...LOCALLY ENHANCING HAIL/WIND THREAT RESPECTIVELY. SFC DEW POINTS 60S F AND PLUME OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BECOME JUXTAPOSED WITH STRENGTHENING SFC DIABATIC HEATING THROUGH AFTERNOON...RESULTING IN WEAK MLCINH AND POTENTIAL FOR RAPID DEVELOPMENT/GROWTH AND UPSCALE MERGER OF CONVECTION. AS SUCH...AGGREGATED COLD POOLS MAY DEVELOP IN SOME AREAS...ALSO LOCALLY ENHANCING WIND THREAT. OVERALL SVR POTENTIAL SHOULD WANE AFTER DARK...AS COMBINATION OF OUTFLOW POOLS AND SFC COOLING REDUCES BUOYANCY. COVERAGE/DURATION SHOULD DIMINISH FROM MID-SOUTH WWD OVER ERN OK.

sections.text: WITH FRONTAL/PREFRONTAL REGIME...ANOTHER RELATIVELY CONCENTRATED AREA OF STG-SVR TSTMS MAY DEVELOP DURING AFTERNOON.
